observations: Game console with a three-tier design characteristic of a PS4 Pro.
Console is covered in a grey and white patterned skin.
Two camouflage-patterned wireless controllers are placed on top of the console.
The background shows a retail environment with boxes for JBL speakers (Charge 5, Charge 6, Flip 7) and a selfie stick.
Watermark 'RICHARD IHEYI' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' appears on all photos.
The console is being held by a hand in photos 1 and 2.

claims.evidence: The exterior looks clean with the skin, but internal wear or noise cannot be assessed.
The three-tier chassis design visible in photos 0, 1, and 2 is unique to the PS4 Pro model.
There are no photos of the console's user interface or library screen.
Two camouflage controllers are clearly visible in all photos.

risks.risk: Console may not boot or may have a 'Blue Light of Death' (BLOD).
risks.proof: A video of the console booting to the main menu.

risks.risk: The internal fan may be excessively loud or the console may overheat.
risks.proof: A video of the console running a demanding game for several minutes.
risks.if_unproven: as needing internal cleaning and thermal paste replacement

risks.risk: Controllers may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video showing the controllers being used to navigate menus or play a game.

risks.risk: The optical disc drive may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video of a game disc being inserted, recognized, and launched.
risks.if_unproven: as having a broken disc drive

risks.risk: Installed games may be digital and tied to an account that is not being transferred or could be revoked.
risks.proof: Confirmation of account ownership transfer and a photo of the games library.

risks.risk: The console might be banned from the PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A photo of the console successfully logged into a PSN account.

proof_requests: Video of the console booting up and navigating the home menu.
Photo of the 'System Information' screen showing the software version and storage capacity.
Photo of the 'Storage' menu showing installed games.
Video of a disc being inserted and loaded by the console.
Video demonstrating both controllers working without stick drift.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a PS4 Pro with two controllers based on its unique three-tier design. While functionality is unproven, it can be priced at a worst-case 'not working' or 'parts only' value until proof of operation is provided.
